name: Dead Man Incorporated
description: Dead Man Incorporated (DMI) is a predominantly white organized crime enterprise founded in 2000 in the Maryland Department of Corrections by Perry Roark, James Sweeney, and Brian Jordan. Initially allied with the Black Guerrilla Family, DMI expanded into murder-for-hire, drug trafficking, extortion, and armed robbery, operating through prison units and street-level cells across Maryland and several other states.
